about: What changed, in words for friends, newest first. Add a line to the top entry as things merge; start a new entry (the next id) after a release. Each release's notes start with the entries it adds, and the app shows people the ones they haven't seen.

items: New hearths start with a Campfire. If the voice server can't be reached, joining a fire says so, with Try again.
Peiskos tells you when you're removed from a hearth or it's deleted, and when the room you're typing in goes away (your unsent message can be copied).
_Underscores_ make italics too, and editing a long message gives you a box big enough to see it.

Pop out the game you're playing into its own window, from the button next to Back to the fire: the casino, Fireside Angler, Stockpile or Melon Bomber (between rounds). In the desktop app the pin keeps it on top.
Confirmations and errors are Peiskos's own now, instead of your browser's pop-ups. Deleting a hearth asks you to type its name.
A hearth's settings, Your account and Server admin are one page each, with sections down the side. On phones, a hearth's settings start as a list.
New friends get a short welcome: a picture and name, alerts, and a mic check. Every step can be skipped.
Rooms show placeholders while they load, and messages show just the time under the date line.
Light, dark or match your device is in Your account › Settings.
